==About Voicelines==
{{VO
|character                   = Iuno
|language                    = en

<!-- Thoughts -->
|vo_01_01_title              = Thoughts: I
|vo_01_01_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg
|vo_01_01_tx                 = A void… I was taken aback when I first heard Grandmother Lillibet describe you as such. We Priestesses revere the Sacred Flames, for their light grants us revelation. Wherever it shines, shadows and reflections emerge. Yet a void... Could it be a barrier, or perhaps some form of falsity that refuses to be seen? As the Unwritten One, do you embody endless unpredictability, or is it an absolute emptiness? Only now, walking this path with you, do I understand. This void is nothing obscure. It's like Chaos, yet different. It's where countless possibilities wait to be chosen.

|vo_01_02_title              = Thoughts: II
|vo_01_02_intimacy           = 1
|vo_01_02_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg
|vo_01_02_tx                 = Seeing is simple. But facing what you see isn't. It may be a blessing to see the future, but the real curse is knowing what's coming and being powerless to stop it. Yet I won't accept the prophesized end. Only the weak would stand by and just watch it all unfold... I must try to make a change. Even if I have to look at the same agonizing truth over and over again. Even if the struggle never ends. Even if I'm only giving fate a little dent.

|vo_01_03_title              = Thoughts: III
|vo_01_03_intimacy           = 2
|vo_01_03_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg
|vo_01_03_tx                 = What would happen if I shot that arrow...? Well, I sort of knew what to expect. My existence... might vanish completely, or simply fade from others' memory. In the years of using the Moon Arrow to mark and uncloak the {{Extra Effect|Dark Tide|Dark Tide|A Waveworn Phenomenon unique to Rinascita, the Dark Tide is a manifestation of the Threnodian Leviathan's power of Unity. Dark clouds amass overhead and crash down like a waterfall, surging in all directions. Wherever the Dark Tide spreads, it spawns Tacet Discords and scars the land with Tidal Blight. At its epicenter, a new Tacet Field forms.}}'s creations, I experienced that too many times. The costs were always small, and the reactions were barely noticeable. At most, people's memories of me would grow hazy for a few days, and I would have to remind them who I was... That much I can bear. And to rewrite the whole end at such a cost? Quite the bargain no matter how you look at it, right?

|vo_01_04_title              = Thoughts: IV
|vo_01_04_intimacy           = 3
|vo_01_04_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg
|vo_01_04_tx                 = Sometimes those who remember suffer more than those who forget. To remember is to bear a weight, to remain unbroken when you'd rather break, and to be forced to carry on. Forgive me... Back then, I had no clue that returning to the real world was even possible, and because of that, this selfish desire of mine for you to remember me now looks even more willful... But even if I had to do it all again, I'd still... If anyone were to remember me, to keep some piece of me alive, it would be you. You'd be the exception.

|vo_01_05_title              = Thoughts: V
|vo_01_05_intimacy           = 4
|vo_01_05_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg
|vo_01_05_tx                 = What will I do now? I haven't decided yet. Well... I spent so much time looking into the future that the idea of living in the present feels strange. But now, Septimont and I are in the same position. No more chains. No more limits. Just endless possibilities spread out before us. With so many paths to take, why rush to choose the "best" one? I'll just do what I feel is right, and take what I truly want... And right now? This is what I want. That's for sure.


<!-- Miscellaneous -->
|vo_02_01_title              = Iuno's Hobby
|vo_02_01_file               = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg
|vo_02_01_tx                 = I love surprises. Fate can be generous and stingy at the same time. To outsmart it and bring about some "accidents" takes real work. Countless preparations, endless calculations... Until you finally make something completely unexpected real. For such extraordinary feats, no matter how big or small, I'll always give them my wholehearted applause.

|vo_02_02_title              = Iuno's Trouble
|vo_02_02_file               = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg
|vo_02_02_tx                 = Settling for less? No. Never an option. It has to be my favorite and most satisfying choice... Others, you say? How they choose to handle things is never my problem, so naturally, I haven't the slightest care as to what they say.

|vo_02_03_title              = Favorite Food
|vo_02_03_file               = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg
|vo_02_03_tx                 = A perfectly ripe, plump fruit, fresh and begging to be eaten. You don't even have to pick it yourself. Just stand under the tree, and it'll drop right into your hands. Take a bite, and its cool, juicy sweetness flows out from the pulp... With all that said, why not try one together?

|vo_02_04_title              = Disliked Food
|vo_02_04_file               = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg
|vo_02_04_tx                 = Ugh, protein dishes should be less greasy, lightly seasoned, and absolutely free of any gamey or fishy flavors. And mushy vegetables? Out of the question... And don't get me started on those foods with sticky, sloppy textures. They've got no strength at all! Also... What's that look on your face? I'm not finished yet!

|vo_02_05_title              = Ideals
|vo_02_05_file               = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg
|vo_02_05_tx                 = Fight against fate? No, not exactly. In the end, I just willfully chose the freedom I wanted. When fate refuses to give people what they desire, they have to claim it themselves. I just happen to be greedy and blatant, taking what I want recklessly, honestly, and gracefully... As for the price, is there anything that doesn't come with it?


<!-- Chat -->
|vo_03_01_title              = Chat: I
|vo_03_01_file               = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg
|vo_03_01_tx                 = That bow, crafted from Lunarum Bough, was the last thing my father left me. I got it when I'd just decided to become a Priestess and prepared to leave for the Tetragon Temple, and never thought I'd need to use it back then. But over time, I realized I rather take fate into my own hands than spend my days praying to some higher power. And now, the one who once merely followed the moon's guidance and traces has become one who dominates and anchors its phases. This "lunar arc" has long been rooted in the causality of my story, tying my beginning to my end.

|vo_03_02_title              = Chat: II
|vo_03_02_file               = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg
|vo_03_02_tx                 = Well, just as Grandmother Lillibet prophesized, I... Wait, haven't you already witnessed my whole past in the Chaos? It's so strange to repeat what others already know... B-but fine! I'll tell you again... But only because I'm gracious! And as I said before, don't tell anyone else! And don't you dare forget a single word!


<!-- About Others -->
|vo_04_01_title              = About [[Augusta]]
|vo_04_01_intimacy           = 1
|vo_04_01_file               = {character}{language} About Augusta.ogg
|vo_04_01_tx                 = Here's a little secret even Augusta doesn't know. When we first met, I told her she'd lead Septimont into a new era, and she believed it to be one of my prophecies. But really, it was just a hunch. I never peep into her fate because it's always been in her hands. She's the kind of ruler who'd sacrifice everything for her people, even her own flesh and blood. You don't need a coronation to see that. It's obvious at a glance. Yet, that kind of responsibility she carries is heavier than anyone else can imagine. Even though I know she can handle it alone, I still want to help somehow. As a Priestess, as a friend... or even as someone she has forgotten.
|vo_04_01_mention            = Augusta

|vo_04_02_title              = About [[Lillibet]]
|vo_04_02_intimacy           = 2
|vo_04_02_file               = {character}{language} About Lillibet.ogg
|vo_04_02_tx                 = After prophesizing about me, Grandmother Lillibet took me to the Tetragon Temple to teach me everything about fate. I'm never the obedient type, and she's more of the authoritative model of what Septimont expects in a Priestess. We rarely saw eye to eye on what makes the most gifted Priestess or how to handle fate and prophecies. But she never forced her views on me, never pushed me to be like her or any other Priestesses. She said rules only matter if they're worth following, and one is always free to choose as long as they do not harm others... She taught me that Priestesses aren't just symbols fixed on the wall, but living, breathing people, too.
|vo_04_02_mention            = Lillibet

|vo_04_03_title              = About [[Lupa]]
|vo_04_03_intimacy           = 3
|vo_04_03_file               = {character}{language} About Lupa.ogg
|vo_04_03_tx                 = Anyone who's seen her matches probably feels the urge to challenge her as well, wouldn't you agree? Her passion for competition is really something... Pure, simple, and completely genuine. For her, victory and glory are just icing on the cake compared to the joy of the fight. She's not afraid to lose, but her passion always drives her to give her all and never back down, no matter the odds.
|vo_04_03_mention            = Lupa

|vo_04_04_title              = About [[Avidius]]
|vo_04_04_intimacy           = 4
|vo_04_04_file               = {character}{language} About Avidius.ogg
|vo_04_04_tx                 = He roared at fate with everything he had. Sure, that roar was swiftly reduced to whimpers, then silence, but we all heard it. It left its mark... I think he's more like the Hero of Heroes when he stops worrying about what that even means or what others expect from him.
|vo_04_04_mention            = Avidius

|vo_04_05_title              = About [[Carlotta]]
|vo_04_05_intimacy           = 5
|vo_04_05_file               = {character}{language} About Carlotta.ogg
|vo_04_05_tx                 = She and her family always manage to bring something fresh to Septimont and Ragunna, even to themselves. And before you know it, those little novelties spark whole new trend.... Me? Yep, I usually end up buying whatever it is. It's just hard to resist. She always gets what I like. Those Montellis, cunning as ever!
|vo_04_05_mention            = Carlotta


<!-- Birthday -->
|vo_05_01_title              = Birthday Wishes
|vo_05_01_file               = {character}{language} Birthday Wishes.ogg
|vo_05_01_tx                 = For a Priestess, the day of birth is the starting point that stretches towards the end. Hmm, a rather suitable line to mark the beginning of a prophecy. But the infinite possibilities of the void are already perfect. There's nothing more I could offer. So, I've prepared something else. See this little moon? It can change its phases. Take it and place it in your void. If you ever find the infinite paths ahead overwhelming, it will at least serve as an anchor of certainty... Happy Birthday, {{Rover}}.

|vo_06_01_tx                 = (Effort sounds)

|vo_06_02_title              = Idle: II
|vo_06_02_file               = {character}{language} Idle II.ogg

|vo_06_03_title              = Idle: III
|vo_06_03_file               = {character}{language} Idle III.ogg
|vo_06_03_tx                 = Pleasing to the ears, hm?


<!-- Greetings -->
|vo_07_01_title              = Self-Introduction
|vo_07_01_file               = {character}{language} Self-Introduction.ogg
|vo_07_01_tx                 = Iuno, the prodigy born under the lunar eclipse. The Priestess who sees the true future. Curious about what lies ahead? Come to me... But no promises of the perfect ending you seek.

|vo_07_02_title              = Greeting
|vo_07_02_file               = {character}{language} Greeting.ogg
|vo_07_02_tx                 = Beyond myself. Beyond every written start and end of the story. Till we rewrite our fate.


<!-- Join Team -->
|vo_08_01_title              = Join Team: I
|vo_08_01_file               = {character}{language} Join Team I.ogg
|vo_08_01_tx                 = Very well. I shall grant you enlightenment.

|vo_08_02_title              = Join Team: II
|vo_08_02_file               = {character}{language} Join Team II.ogg
|vo_08_02_tx                 = Oh. What will you do without me?

|vo_08_03_title              = Join Team: III
|vo_08_03_file               = {character}{language} Join Team III.ogg
|vo_08_03_tx                 = I am the moon that never falls, here to rewrite the ending.


<!-- Ascension -->
|vo_09_01_title              = Ascension: I
|vo_09_01_ascension          = 1
|vo_09_01_file               = {character}{language} Ascension I.ogg
|vo_09_01_tx                 = My powers keep manifesting like my emotions, memories, and connections... You've become quite adept at this anchor job, haven't you?

|vo_09_02_title              = Ascension: II
|vo_09_02_ascension          = 2
|vo_09_02_file               = {character}{language} Ascension II.ogg
|vo_09_02_tx                 = From one moon to another, through endless cycles... until it's beyond measurement.

|vo_09_03_title              = Ascension: III
|vo_09_03_ascension          = 3
|vo_09_03_file               = {character}{language} Ascension III.ogg
|vo_09_03_tx                 = Are you sure about this? Indulging my willfulness? Just so you know, if we keep this up, we might... fall into an unknown future scarier than Chaos!

|vo_09_04_title              = Ascension: IV
|vo_09_04_ascension          = 4
|vo_09_04_file               = {character}{language} Ascension IV.ogg
|vo_09_04_tx                 = Can I have anything else I want other than power? Think carefully before you answer. Once you say it, I won't stop until I get it.

|vo_09_05_title              = Ascension: V
|vo_09_05_ascension          = 5
|vo_09_05_file               = {character}{language} Ascension V.ogg
|vo_09_05_tx                 = I see cold flames beyond the edge of reason. I see perfection rising from the shattered end. I see Chaos. I see illusions. I see truths. I see... you, the one who captured the moon.
}}
